mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 650K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 650K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, indicating supply chain resilience, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3% YoY, signaling robust aggregate demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points within a quarter, indicating a monetary policy shift, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 7% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) growth is below 2% YoY, the combined signal of low inflation and strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical inflation and labor market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% YoY, indicating strong consumer spending, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical retail sales and market correlations
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 5% YoY.
